meetingPoint.title: Where does your driver wait?
meetingPoint.subtitle: Your meeting point guide for Munich Airport
meetingPoint.intro: So you can arrive relaxed after landing, here's exactly where and how to find your driver at Munich Airport – for both Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
meetingPoint.waitText: We monitor your flight in real time. If your landing is delayed, your driver automatically adjusts the pickup time and waits up to 60 minutes free of charge – no surcharge.
meetingPoint.trackingText: As soon as you provide your flight number at booking, we track your flight automatically. Your driver knows exactly when you land – even with delays or gate changes.
meetingPoint.signTitle: Meet & greet with a name sign
meetingPoint.signText: Your driver will be waiting right in the arrivals area holding a clearly visible sign with your name. You'll spot them instantly, even in a crowded terminal.
meetingPoint.terminal1Text: Terminal 1 is divided into modules A, B, C, D, E and F. After baggage claim, follow the signs to the "Terminal 1" arrivals area – your driver waits there with a name sign. Just let us know your exact module when booking and we'll find you even faster.
meetingPoint.terminal2Text: Terminal 2 has its own arrivals area. Your driver waits right at the arrivals hall exit. Same as always: name sign, on time, watching your flight status.
meetingPoint.macText: The MAC connects Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 and sits centrally between them. If needed, we can also arrange a meeting point here – just let us know.

steps.title: Provide your flight number at booking
steps.text: This lets us track your flight from the very start.

steps.title: After landing: baggage & exit
steps.text: Take your time at baggage claim and the exit – we'll be waiting.

steps.title: Find your driver in the arrivals area
steps.text: Look out for the sign with your name on it.

steps.title: Direct contact if needed
steps.text: You'll receive your driver's phone number by email – call or send a message any time.

faqs.q: What happens if I can't find my driver?
faqs.a: You'll receive your driver's phone number before the trip. Just call or message us on WhatsApp – we'll help you right away.

faqs.q: Do I need to know the exact module at Terminal 1?
faqs.a: No, that's not required. If you know it, feel free to add it at booking – it makes the pickup even smoother.

faqs.q: What if my flight is delayed?
faqs.a: No problem. We track your flight automatically and adjust the pickup time. You won't pay any surcharge for up to 60 minutes of waiting.

faqs.q: Does the driver wait if my flight lands early?
faqs.a: Yes, our driver is always on site by the scheduled arrival time and waits until you come through the arrivals area.
